title: CrabCity v5.x Authentication Mod
description: A mod that supports cross-server authorization by using CrabCity API.
body:
# Introduction
Based on CrabCity API, this mod can bring a cross-platform user authorization to help you manage your server more easily.

# How to use
1. Install this on your server
2. Get your server's token from HeyCrab3
3. Create a file named "cc_blacklist_auth_server_token.txt" on the root directory of the server
4. Put your token in the file, and make sure that there's only 1 row in the file
5. Done
